free.a: Yes, for one pet: health record, reminders, calendar and species guides included. Premium is for when you look after several pets; you subscribe in the mobile app, and the price is shown there before any purchase.

account.a: No. You can start right away, without an account. A free account backs up your data so you can find it on another device.

upgrade.q: If I create an account later, will I lose what I've logged?
upgrade.a: No. Your pet and its record are attached to your new account, with nothing to re-enter.

animals.q: Which animals can I keep track of?
animals.a: Dogs, cats, rabbits and rodents, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, horses, poultry… The guides draw on GBIF, the global biodiversity database, and keep growing.

vet.a: No, and that's not its job. Captivia helps you forget nothing and arrive at the appointment with a complete history. The health guides tell you what should prompt a visit.

data.q: Where is my pet's data stored?
data.a: On a server and a database located in Frankfurt, Germany. It is never sold or rented, and you can delete it at any time.

devices.q: Which devices does Captivia work on?
devices.a: Computers, tablets and phones, in the browser. The Android and iOS apps use the same account.

plans.whereText: Premium is purchased in the Captivia app, through the App Store or Google Play. The website takes no payments.
plans.freePriceNote: No time limit, no credit card.
plans.freePoint2: Reminders, the care agenda and calendar subscription
plans.freePoint3: A printable record to hand to your vet
plans.premiumPriceNote: Price shown in the app before any purchase.

plans.premiumPoint2: A public page and a QR code for each animal

features.publicPage: Public animal page and QR code

plans.faq1A: In the Captivia mobile app, with your App Store or Google Play account. The website shows your subscription but sells nothing.
plans.faq2A: Any time, from your store’s subscription settings. Premium stays active until the end of the period already paid.
plans.faq3A: Trying without an account covers one animal. For Premium, create an account first: your animal and its record are kept.

paywall.termsIos: Auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. soon.title: The community opens soon
soon.body: Photos of your pets, questions for fellow enthusiasts, answers that actually help: everything is ready, we just need to open the doors. Your pets' health record stays private.

join.title: Fellow pet people are waiting
join.body: Show your pets, ask your questions and answer other people's. A free account is all you need to join the community.
join.privacy: Your pets' health record is never published: you choose what you share, one post at a time.

emailNotVerified.body: Open the link we e-mailed you to post in the community. Nothing arrived? We can send it again.

ageRequired.body: The community is open from age 15. Confirm it when you create your profile.

profileRequired.title: Choose your username
profileRequired.body: Create your public profile (a username, and an avatar if you like) to post, reply and like.

profileExists.body: You can change your username and avatar from your profile.

rulesNotAccepted.title: The rules have changed
rulesNotAccepted.body: Read and accept the new version of the rules to keep posting.

suspended.body: You can still read and like, but not post or reply for now. The decision and how to appeal are available.

handleReserved.body: This username is reserved or looks too much like a protected one (letters swapped for digits, for example). Choose another one.

handleTaken.title: Username already taken
handleTaken.body: This username is taken, or another member gave it up recently (it stays reserved for 60 days). Add a number or a word: “kaa_and_me”, “gecko.lea”.

mediaTooLarge.title: Photo too heavy
mediaTooLarge.body: Choose a lighter or smaller photo: 8 MB at most, 10,000 px per side and 24 megapixels at most.

mediaInvalid.title: Unreadable photo
mediaInvalid.body: This photo couldn't be read, or it is too stretched (panorama, very long screenshot). Choose another one or crop it.

mediaDimensions.title: Unusual photo size
mediaDimensions.body: This photo is too stretched or too large. Crop it, then try again.

mediaBusy.title: Can't upload right now
mediaBusy.body: Lots of photos are arriving at once. Try again in a moment.

appealNotAllowed.title: Appeal not possible

bodyRequired.title: Some text is needed

invalidParent.title: Can't reply
invalidParent.body: This comment is no longer visible.

notAuthor.title: For the question's author only
notAuthor.body: Only the person who asked the question picks the helpful answer.

notFound.title: Not found

rule.one: Kindness first: answer the question, not the person.
rule.two: Health: advice never replaces a vet. When in doubt, point people to one.
rule.three: No selling animals, no personal data, no advertising.

profile.leaveConfirmBody: Everything you've posted disappears, photos included. This can't be undone.
profile.dataNote: Community data is described in our privacy policy.

member.emptyBody: This member hasn't posted anything yet.
member.emptyMineBody: A photo, a question: members will discover your pets here.

blocks.title: Blocked people
blocks.lead: You no longer see their posts or replies, and they no longer see yours. They aren't notified.
blocks.emptyBody: Is a member bothering you? Block them from their profile or one of their posts: neither of you will see the other.
blocks.confirmBody: You won't see their posts or replies any more, and they won't see yours. They aren't notified, and you can undo it at any time.

decisions.title: Decisions and reports
decisions.lead: Moderation decisions about your content or account, with their reasons and the option to challenge them.
decisions.emptyBody: If one of your posts is ever hidden or deleted, you'll find the reason here and how to challenge it.
decisions.notFoundBody: This link doesn't match any decision on your account. Check that you're signed in to the right account.
decisions.detailLead: What was decided, why, and how to challenge it.

target.gone: Content deleted. It is no longer shown.

decisions.automatedYes: Yes: hidden after several reports, pending review by a person
decisions.automatedNo: No: decided by a person on the team
decisions.appealPendingBody: Your appeal is in the hands of a person on the team. You'll get their answer by e-mail.
decisions.appealIntro: Appeals are free and reviewed by someone who didn't take the original decision. Explain what the team may have misunderstood.
decisions.appealSentBody: We'll answer by e-mail. The answer will also appear here.
decisions.appealClosed: This decision can no longer be challenged in the app (already appealed or 6-month deadline passed).
decisions.remediesBody: You can also turn to a certified out-of-court dispute settlement body, or to the courts. These options remain open whatever the outcome of your appeal.

reports.title: My reports
reports.empty: You haven't reported anything. Thanks for keeping an eye out.
reports.error: Your reports can't be shown right now.

rules.title: Community rules
rules.lead: A place to share our love for our animals and help each other. These rules keep it pleasant for everyone.

kind.title: Kindness first
kind.body: Answer the question, not the person. No insults, targeted mockery, harassment or hateful language.

animals.title: Animal welfare above all
animals.body: No images or advice that trivialise an animal's suffering. Worried about living conditions? Report it rather than arguing about it.

health.title: Advice doesn't replace a vet
health.body: Share your experience, cite your sources, and point to a vet at the slightest worrying sign. Dangerous advice is removed.

trade.title: No selling or swapping animals
trade.body: The community isn't a marketplace. Trading protected species is illegal and reported to the authorities.

privacy.title: Everyone's privacy
privacy.body: No addresses, phone numbers or full names, neither yours nor anyone else's. Check that no photo shows your address.

spam.title: No advertising
spam.body: No promotion and no repeated messages. Links are allowed once an account is 7 days old.

honest.title: Be yourself
honest.body: A username of your own, photos you have the right to share, and nobody but you behind the profile.

process.report: Any member can report content. After several reports, it is hidden until a person on the team reviews it.
process.decision: Every decision (hiding, deletion, suspension) is explained to you by e-mail and in the app, with its reason.
process.appeal: You can challenge it for free for 6 months: a person reviews your case and answers you.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.lead: Reports, hidden content, appeals and log. Every decision needs a reason and an explanation, sent to the author.
moderation.forbiddenBody: This page is open to operators whose e-mail address is verified.
moderation.openReports: {count, plural, one {# open report} other {# open reports}}
moderation.details: {count, plural, one {See the reporter's details} other {See the # reporters' details}}
moderation.queueEmptyBody: The queue is empty. New reports will appear here, oldest first.
moderation.hiddenEmptyBody: Content hidden automatically or by the team will appear here.
moderation.appealsEmptyBody: Members' appeals will appear here, oldest first.
moderation.logEmptyBody: Every decision, even automated ones, will be recorded here.

form.reasonRequired: Choose the reason for the decision.
form.statementHint: Sent to the author: what exactly is wrong.
form.daysRange: Enter a number of days between 1 and {max}.

hide.title: Hide this content
hide.body: Only its author can still see it. Reports are closed and the author receives your explanation.

delete.title: Delete permanently
delete.body: The content and its images are erased. An appeal can't bring it back: keep this for clearly illegal or serious content.

restore.title: Restore this content
restore.body: The content becomes visible again and won't be hidden automatically any more. The author is notified.

dismiss.title: Dismiss the reports
dismiss.body: The content stays visible and won't be hidden automatically any more. The author isn't notified.

suspend.title: Suspend @{handle}
suspend.body: The member can still read and like, but can no longer post, reply, or change username or avatar.

unsuspend.title: Lift @{handle}'s suspension
unsuspend.body: The member can post again. They are notified.

uphold.title: Uphold the decision
uphold.body: The decision stays in place. The member receives your answer.

reverse.title: Reverse the decision
reverse.body: The hidden content is restored or the suspension lifted. The member receives your answer.
